coverage: 14 first-level units: 13 municipalities (including Ataúro) and the Special Administrative Region of Oe-Cusse Ambeno. Ataúro is separate from Díli, effective 1 January 2022. Geometry is the licensed DGE/OCHA 2020 COD snapshot, with exact former Ataúro post TL0604 promoted to municipality and removed from Díli. National border arcs follow the existing BPS Indonesian land edge for display consistency. Only municipality-level boundaries are exposed: the retained 65-post/442-suco files predate current reforms and are not published as current divisions. Population is the official September 2025 municipal register, not a census or a 2026 estimate. Official 2026 law recognizes 472 sucos; no matching licensed polygon source was found.
processing: Full available source resolution retained, cleaned together and rounded to six decimal places. Shared internal edges stored once; unselected coasts have no stroke. Deeper geometry loads only for the selected region. All views use the shared regional renderer, selected-outline index, adaptive detail, lifecycle and three-country cache. Territorial waters are excluded from land fills. Territory context features carry their own destination bounds.
